description:
**Description**
Prime Video is changing the way people watch movies, TV shows, and live sports, offering a vast library of content to a global audience. We are constantly innovating to enhance the customer experience, from how content is discovered and consumed to how we produce and deliver it at scale. Our mission is to be the premier entertainment destination, and we achieve this through a relentless focus on the customer, a passion for storytelling, and a commitment to technical excellence.

Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including design reviews, code reviews, and operational support, while adhering to engineering best practices.
  
  
Work backwards from business needs to build features and systems that directly impact our internal customers and improve efficiency.

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (Java Heavy)
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**Position Description**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join the Advanced Integration Builder team within Okta. This team builds and maintains the backend services, provisioning frameworks, authentication connectors, and next-generation Entitlement Management engines that let Okta customers secure, integrate, and govern access to thousands of third-party enterprise applications — from modern cloud platforms (Microsoft Office 365, Workday, Salesforce, AWS, ServiceNow) and AI agentic systems to legacy on-prem systems. As a Senior Engineer, you will own the technical design and implementation of integration components end-to-end: REST/SOAP API clients, OAuth2/SAML authentication flows, user and group provisioning/sync jobs, and the retry and rate-limiting logic required to operate reliably against dozens of idiosyncratic third-party vendor APIs at scale. This is a backend-intensive role — the large majority of your time will be spent in Java/Spring Boot services — but you'll also need decent frontend experience in React and JSP to build and extend the screens that surface integration configuration to customers

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**
- Feature Execution: Drive technical design and implementation of integration features — new app connectors, provisioning/sync capabilities, authentication flows — primarily in backend Java services, extending into React/JSP configuration screens.
  
- Build and maintain REST/SOAP API clients, OAuth2/SAML authentication handlers , and vendor-specific exception/error-mapping layers for third-party SaaS and enterprise applications.
  
- Implement and extend user/group provisioning adapters built on shared contracts and scheduled sync/import jobs that keep identity data consistent between Okta and external systems.
  
- Resilience at Scale: Apply retry/backoff, rate-limiting, and pagination strategies to handle vendor API quirks, throttling, and intermittent failures gracefully across the dozens of concurrently supported integrations.
  
- Security & Compliance: Ensure credential/secret handling, token exchange, and audit logging for provisioning operations meet Okta's security and compliance standards.
  
- Product & Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with PMs, support, and technical leads to prioritize new app integrations, resolve customer-reported connectivity issues, and participate in technical interviews/recruiting.
  
- Operational Excellence: Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues in integration pipelines, drive root-cause analyses, and improve observability/alerting for sync and provisioning jobs.
  
- Code Quality & Technical Standards: Participate in code reviews, write thorough unit and functional tests, and maintain clear technical documentation.
  
**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**
- Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience building and operating reliable, production-grade backend services.
  
- Backend Expertise: Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot; comfortable owning services end-to-end from design through production support.
  
- Distributed Systems: Experience with asynchronous job processing, scheduled/batch sync jobs, and event-driven patterns.
  
- Data Management: Proficiency with relational databases (MySQL) and caching layers (Redis or similar).
  
- Resilient Systems Design: Practical experience with retry/backoff strategies, rate-limiting, and handling pagination/throttling quirks from third-party APIs.
  
- API Design: Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs, including clients for third-party vendor systems with varying levels of API quality and documentation.
  
- Problem Solving & Ownership: Ability to break down ambiguous integration requirements and independently drive a feature from design to production.
  
- Decent Frontend Experience: While the role is backend-dominant, you should be comfortable building and modifying UI in React and JSP — well enough to independently deliver the frontend without relying on a dedicated frontend engineer.
  
**Nice to Haves**
- Experience with identity/IAM standards (SCIM, SAML, OAuth, OIDC) or directory services (AD, LDAP).
  
-Integration & Auth Protocols: Working knowledge of REST/SOAP API integration patterns and authentication standards such as OAuth2, SAML, or WS-Federation.
  
- Exposure to legacy protocol support (SOAP-based provisioning services) alongside modern REST/OAuth integrations.
  
- Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architectures or specialized compliance environments (e.g., FedRAMP/GCC-High).
  
- Experience with message brokers/queueing systems (Kafka) for asynchronous processing.
  
- Exposure to HTTP mocking/test-server frameworks (e.g., WireMock or equivalent internal mock-server tooling) for API-level testing.
  
**Education**
B.E./M.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Job Summary**
Job Summary
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Senior Android Software Engineer who possesses in-depth knowledge of the Android ecosystem, a passion for security-first development, and a strong product commitment. In this role, you will be a key player in designing, developing, and securing new features for our primary Android mobile products.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Technical Leadership: Drive the architecture, implementation, and maintenance of our core Android solutions, ensuring high performance, quality, and responsiveness.
* End-to-End Ownership: Oversee the development lifecycle from prototyping and implementation to testing, delivery, and ongoing maintenance.
* Security & Best Practices: Define and evangelize development best practices with a strict focus on code robustness, mobile security, scalability, and performance.
* Collaboration & Alignment: Work closely with Product Management, Sales, UX designers, and backend engineering teams to align on product roadmaps and backend API design.
* Customer & Field Support: Interface with Support and field teams to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex customer escalations in large-scale enterprise deployments.
* Mentorship: Lead brainstorming and design sessions, providing ongoing technical direction and code reviews for teammates across multiple global sites.
* Innovation: Stay ahead of the curve regarding evolving mobile technologies, Android OS updates, and relevant open-source libraries.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of professional software development experience, with 3+ years dedicated to the Android platform and at least 2 years in a technical leadership or lead role.
* Strong proficiency in Kotlin and Java, alongside a deep understanding of core Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts.
* Deep understanding of modern Android architecture patterns (MVVM, MVI, MVP) and UI patterns (including Material Design).
* Strong understanding of multithreading, concurrency, and asynchronous programming concepts.
* Experience with Android testing frameworks (Espresso, JUnit) and a solid understanding of Git workflows and CI/CD pipelines.
* Proven knowledge of code signing and distributing applications through the Google Play Store, as well as managing dependencies via Maven/Gradle.
* Solid understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) concepts, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SCIM, and token-based authentication.
* Familiarity with user directory concepts like Active Directory, user groups, authentication/authorization mechanisms, and security policies.
* Understanding of Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), PKI, certificate security, encryption, and secure data storage on mobile devices.
* Basic understanding or experience with cloud platforms, preferably Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Microsoft Azure (IaaS/PaaS).
* Understanding of no-schema (NoSQL) databases and local mobile data persistence.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Basic understanding of iOS development (Swift, Objective-C, XCTest) is a strong plus to help collaborate on cross-platform mobile initiatives.
* Working experience with Mobile Device Management (MDM) or Mobile Application Management (MAM) policies.
* Experience or interest in full-stack web development, Windows programming, or kernel-mode development.
* Exposure to global security compliance and privacy frameworks (e.g., GDPR, SOX, PII, and PHI data handling).

* Write clean, tested code; drive architecture reviews, code reviews, and mentor engineers.

* Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, AI, Engineering, or related field.
* 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years building production AI/ML applications.
* Strong grounding in distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, and microservices.
* Track record delivering enterprise-grade AI solutions from POC to production.

Python (expert), TypeScript/JavaScript, SQL, async programming, REST & gRPC, design patterns

LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG, hybrid search, agentic AI (tool/function calling, MCP, A2A), model training & fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA/PEFT), hyperparameter optimization, GPU optimization, quantization
  
  
**AI Frameworks:**
LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, DSPy, Pydantic AI
  
  
**Cloud AI Platforms:**
Google Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Model Garden
  
  
**ML & MLOps:**
PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, MLflow, Kubeflow, model registry, experiment tracking, continuous training
  
  
**AgentOps & Observability:**
LangSmith/Langfuse/Arize Phoenix, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, New Relic, agent evaluation, cost monitoring
  
  
**Vector Databases:**
Pinecone/Weaviate/Milvus/pgvector/Vertex AI Vector Search/Azure AI Search
  
  
**Cloud & DevOps:**
Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps, CI/CD, IaC
  
  
**Workflow Orchestration:**
Temporal/Argo Workflows/event-driven architecture/message queues

We won't just meet your expectations. We'll defy them. So you'll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you'd expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.

Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.
  
  
We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.
  
  
Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.
  
  
Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Your main task will be to create and maintain ETL flows and BI applications in QlikSense and Looker.
* Your role will require both a deep understanding of the business needs and the skill set to acquire, handle and analyze the relevant data. You will have a close direct connection and collaboration with other groups and departments acting as stakeholders for the applications you develop.
* Our BI team is split across the offices in Athens, Uppsala, Stockholm & India and cater to the whole organization.
* The present role will be specialized towards the Corporate Development department. Our processes and technical setup are mature, but constantly changing and adapting with the business.
* The data you will be using is mostly structured in databases maintained by the IT-department and we use several different database technologies. Less structured data will also occur frequently.
* Working at Etraveli means working at a company with grand plans and great expectations. You will have awesome colleagues together with whom you will solve complex problems in a fast moving business.

Job Requirements
  
  

* Development and maintenance of BI applications in Qlik and Looker (e.g. dashboards, dynamic reports, automatic send outs).
* Development of ETL processes handling both structured and unstructured data
* Information engineering and data modeling
* Working closely and directly with business stakeholders Specification:

+ 5+ years of hands on BI application development experience in Qlik or Looker.
+ 3+ years of hands on experience in ETL development and SQL

* A university degree in a quantitative field (physics, economics, statistics, engineering or similar).
* A passion for both business and numbers
* Excellent communication skills
* Experience of version control using git
* Personality-wise, we believe that you are curious, methodical, ambit

Thorough On Boarding Process
  
  
We are building a stellar onboarding adventure just for you, spanning your first 120 days, including access to learning resources, Q&A sessions with our CEO and a buddy program.
  
  
Competitive Benefits
  
  
We pay fairly and align compensation with your role's impact on the company. Referral bonus, pension and insurances are also applicable, with some variations across our locations.
  
  
Wellbeing & Community
  
  
In order to be the best version of you every day, you need an environment that provides for your wellbeing. From breakfast & good coffee to start your day to healthcare, employee assistance plans and team bonding events we've got you covered!
  
  
Opportunities for Development
  
  
You will find extensive learning opportunities, team training and workshops connected to your role as well as guidance from renown leaders, all provided in a fast pace environment with flat hierarchies.
  
  
Hybrid Work
  
  
We want you to enjoy the best of all worlds and we know that doesn't always mean working at the office. We have a hybrid policy, including working from anywhere 2 weeks every year.
  
  
Diversity disclaimer
  
  
*At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds.*
*During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti-discrimination law or regulation.*

title: Associate Staff Engineer, Service Now(ATF & Testing on GRC module)
description:
**Company Description**
**👋🏼We're Nagarro.**
We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at a scale — across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (17700+ experts across 39 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We are looking for great new colleagues. That is where you come in!
  
  
**Requirements**
Job Description
  
  

* Experience: 4+ Years
* Strong experience in ServiceNow Testing and Automation, particularly Automated Test Framework (ATF).
* Hands-on experience in testing ServiceNow GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) module.
* Experience in testing through ServiceNow platform upgrades and releases.
* Demonstrated experience performing end-to-end testing (manual and automated) in accordance with established software testing life cycle (STLC) methodologies.
* Strong understanding of Test Management and Defect Management processes.
* Good understanding of REST and SOAP APIs, including API testing and automation.
* Experience working in Agile development environments.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow ITSM modules such as Incident, Change, Problem, and CMDB.
* Good to have experience with automation tools such as Cypress, TestComplete, or Robot Framework.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* ServiceNow CSA (Certified System Administrator) certification is mandatory.
* Automated Test Framework (ATF) Micro-Certification is mandatory.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop, configure, and maintain automated test scripts using ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF).
* Ensure the quality, reliability, and stability of ServiceNow applications and modules through effective test automation.
* Collaborate with business and project teams to understand requirements and prepare comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scenarios.
* Execute manual and automated test cases and document test results accurately.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing across ServiceNow applications.
* Conduct testing of ServiceNow GRC module and validate related workflows, controls, and business processes.
* Perform testing across ITSM modules including Incident, Change, Problem, and CMDB.
* Support validation and testing activities during ServiceNow platform upgrades and releases.
* Identify, log, track, and manage defects through their lifecycle until closure.
* Work closely with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to resolve testing issues and ensure application quality.
* Validate REST and SOAP API integrations and support API automation testing activities.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Provide testing status updates, metrics, and reports to project stakeholders.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes, frameworks, and quality assurance practices.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field
